title: skills evals: trigger cases with negatives, a review of over-literal assertions, and cases that run without a project on disk
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and on who files this epic's cards: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. Ruling: #34691 S2 = A. This card is the part of that ruling which #34764 puts out of its scope ("new or edited cases").

## Why

The runner of #34764 grades the catalog's cases as they are written. Run as written, a share of the failures say nothing about the skill: the assertion wanted one exact spelling, or the question assumed a project that was not there. And no case at all asks the first question about a skill: was it loaded when it should be, and left alone when it should not.

Who acts: the devx lane for the cases' form, the skills lane where a case's intent has to be read. Reader: the eval seat, and any seat changing a skill's description.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`; this session ran every case once per arm through `claude -p` on a subscription login, 416 runs, 2026-11-17; scores are with the maintainer)

- Of 15 failing with-skill transcripts read: 4 failed on an over-literal assertion, 2 because the prompt needs a project on disk, 4 because the skill was present and not loaded or not read, 5 on a model error, none because the skill does not teach the answer.
- Over-literal, by case id: `objectstack-automation/flows-triggers-approvals#13` requires the token `hotcrm.custom`, which is absent from that skill; `objectstack-i18n/bundles-locales-coverage#10` forbids `verdict: {`, which a correct answer quotes as the wrong shape.
- 35 of 416 runs ended on a 10-turn limit, mostly searching for a repository that was not there; 138 no-skill and 98 with-skill answers said a project was missing.
- In the with-skill arm the Skill tool was invoked in a minority of runs; the model often reached the text by reading files.
- Directus ships 39 trigger cases, 3 of them negative, graded on whether the skill was loaded, and records 22 of 37 passing before a description change and 33–34 after. Anthropic's skill-creator recommends a 20-query trigger eval run three times.

## Scope

- Review each case's assertions once: a token that is one spelling of a right answer becomes a check any right answer passes; a forbidden token a right answer may quote is narrowed.
- Each case states the context it needs, or carries the files that make it answerable in an empty directory (the format already has `files`, empty in every case today).
- About 40 trigger cases across the six metadata skills, at least one in ten negative, graded on whether the skill was loaded. The runner of #34764 reports them beside the behaviour cases.
- File surface: `skills/*/evals/**`; the runner's grading of a trigger case in `packages/qa/**`.

## Done when

- A re-run of the round shows no failure whose cause is the assertion's spelling or a missing project.
- The description rewrite (#34769) is judged on the trigger cases, before and after.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Blocked on the runner only for its last step.
- Blocked-by: #34764
- Supersedes the extra scope of #34768, which was closed as a duplicate of #34764.
- Dedup, open and closed: `"evals" skills runner in:title` 0 (as #34764 read it); `skill trigger eval` none found.
